· Position vs SMA100 ($40,933)/SMA200 ($32,326) — above mid-to-long-term trends

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.4→51.2) + neutral reading + maintaining upward direction
· MACD histogram trajectory (975.7771→975.7771) + holding steady + no weakening of trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $33,111) + band width 36.27% indicating moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($34,485) + based on Pivot ($33,735) and SMA200 ($32,326)
· Swing resistance ($36,570) with potential for further upside on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + strengthening uptrend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.99x) + moderate confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + buy entry condition on breaking $36,570, shift to wait-and-see on breaking $34,485
